questions.questionHtml:
In triangle ADE, AB = BC = CD, and BD = DE = BE. What is ∠DAE?

त्रिभुज ADE में, AB = BC = CD है और BD = DE = BE है| ∠DAE का मान क्या है?
questions.solution:
Let ∠A = 2θ.

In triangle ABC, ∠ACB = 2θ.

Again ∠ACB = ∠CBD + ∠CDB = 2∠CDB (∵ CB = CD).

∠CDB = θ.

Also, as triangle BDE is equilateral, ∠BDE = ∠E = 60°.

In triangle ADE, 2θ + (θ+ 60) + 60 = 180

or 3θ + 120 = 180 or 2θ = 40.
